fixture_provenance.holdout_excluded: structurally (split gate before any output read; sentinel-proven by bounded_fit_checks T3)

budgets.why: packet budgets verbatim plus preregistered GPU headroom (the small-fixture floor is 384 MiB reported free); an OOM FAILS the job -- never silently change precision, physical steps or drop cases

checkpoint_policy: none: single-pass CPU runs, seconds-scale; the stamped evidence receipt is the only artifact and is never silently overwritten
stopping_conditions: jobs run sequentially in preregistered order; stop on first failure (continue_on_failure false)
stop when the packet's acceptance thresholds are met on the validation split; the physically_qualified flag is the only success marker
an OOM or any packet-limit breach FAILS the job: silently changing precision, physical steps or dropping cases is forbidden
the batch never calls the unloaded language model between jobs; results are read only after the entire suite returns

release_contract.one_reservation: gpu_batch.py invokes the handoff once and holds the OS reservation across every job
release_contract.release_in_cleanup: run_gpu_job's GpuLease closes on success, error and cancellation (context manager); timeouts close the whole owned process tree (OwnedChild); the runner releases in its finally path; the next inference reloads the requested model normally
release_contract.no_model_touching: this manifest's jobs contain no router/HTTP invocation; the batch process must not call the unloaded language model
